name: Windmill
short_desc: Open-source developer platform to turn scripts into webhooks, workflows and UIs
author: Windmill Labs
description: Windmill is an open-source developer platform for building internal tools: APIs, background jobs, workflows, and UIs. Scripts written in Python, TypeScript, Go, Bash, SQL, and more are automatically turned into sharable UIs. Compose them into workflows, trigger via webhooks, schedules, or HTTP routes, and build rich low-code UIs on top — all self-hosted.

form_fields.label: Superadmin Secret
form_fields.hint: Optional secret token for superadmin API access

form_fields.label: Enable NSJAIL sandboxing
form_fields.hint: Set to false to enable NSJAIL sandboxing for filesystem and resource isolation. Default enabled (disabled). See https://www.windmill.dev/docs/advanced/security_isolation

form_fields.label: Enable PID namespace isolation
form_fields.hint: Prevents jobs from accessing parent worker process memory and env vars. Requires privileged mode. See https://www.windmill.dev/docs/advanced/security_isolation
